scope: Rebuild Japanese jet/rocket development from domestic pre-I-29 research plus the revised Yanagi route/information cascade. Separates bench, captive airborne test, self-propelled flight, flight-rated engine, airframe integration and operational evaluation.
authority_note: No 1944 jet combat unit is realized. Later dates are conditional development windows, not guaranteed future history.

source_state_at_1944_01_28.navy_domestic_line: First Air Technical Arsenal TR family began in 1942. Branch metrology/rotor-analysis/process control permits repeatable short self-sustaining bench runs on selected domestic centrifugal/hybrid demonstrators by late 1943, but not durable flight-rated engines.
source_state_at_1944_01_28.army_domestic_line: Army/Kawasaki Ne-0..4 research exists independently. Historical Ne-0 achieved an airborne test; Ne-3/Ne-4 designs were 1943 work with spring-1944 ground-test plans. Keep Army nomenclature and Navy TR/Ne lines separate.
source_state_at_1944_01_28.materials: Selective 20-40 t Ni-equivalent high-temperature research allocation supports multiple prototype material/heat-treatment lots, not mass-production turbine life.
source_state_at_1944_01_28.german_direct_effect_by_date: ZERO physical BMW/Jumo/HWK effect in Japan on 28 Jan 1944. I-30/I-8/RO-500 contribute measurement/fault-diagnosis culture and exchange infrastructure, not a hidden jet engine.

revision_of_old_schedule.old_line: Legacy material used a Mar-May 1944 'Ne-4 pure turbojet first flight' centerline.
reasoning: Historical Japanese Army Ne-0 had airborne auxiliary/ramjet testing and Ne-3/Ne-4 spring-1944 ground-test plans, showing airborne test culture existed, but this is not equivalent to a reliable self-propelled turbojet aircraft.

A self-propelled jet requires engine endurance, throttle/transient control, restart/reliability, inlet/nacelle integration, fuel system, airframe sizing and safe takeoff/landing margins beyond a short bench run.
Branch compute/metrology can advance diagnosis and reduce failed iterations, but does not remove hot-section materials, bearing/seal, balance and control-system bottlenecks.
revision_of_old_schedule.replacement_1944_H1_gate: Q2 1944 captive-carry / underwing airborne hot-run and thrust/combustion measurement is strongly plausible on domestic lines; self-propelled pure-jet airframe is not centered in Mar-May.

conditional_development_timeline_centerl.state: Domestic TR/Army Ne research only. Short repeatable bench runs exist on selected demonstrators; no flight-rated turbojet, no operational jet airframe, no German physical jet hardware in Japan.

Domestic bench endurance/throttle-band work continues. Army Ne-3/Ne-4 and Navy TR lines remain separate. If I-34 reaches Europe in early Feb, Mitsubishi engineers/technical party inspect BMW003/Jumo004/Me262/Me163 and German production/test practice. Low-bandwidth secure technical summaries can reach Japan in late Feb/Mar without waiting for the hull return.
conditional_development_timeline_centerl.organizational_effect_if_gate_opens: Create an inter-service axial-reference/test conference around Mar-Apr: common measurement terms, requested German measurements and a parallel axial study. It does not merge Army/Navy production programs or eliminate rivalry.

conditional_development_timeline_centerl.state: Domestic centrifugal/hybrid engines attempt longer selected bench runs and captive airborne hot-run/thrust measurements. A low-value rush to a dedicated pure-jet flight is not preferred. If I-34 Europe-information gate opened, an axial preliminary layout is already being worked from textual dimensions/stage architecture while exact profiles remain unknown.

Conditional I-34 return information/small-hardware gate may deliver drawings, measurements, samples and control/bearing parts to Southeast Asia/Japan before or near I-29's historical July Singapore information gate. Center cargo is precision information/small hardware rather than a duplicate full engine. If I-34 fails on return, the earlier secure textual summaries are still retained.

Conditional I-29 Singapore information gate delivers fuller Me262/Me163/BMW003-related blueprints/photos and personnel notes by air. If I-29 then survives the separate Japan hardware gate, Jumo004B/HWK509A-1 physical artifacts can reach Japan around late Jul/Aug. Do not assume a physical BMW003 engine.

Detailed practical axial engine design freezes only after enough exact paper/measurement input exists. Domestic TR/Ne test data are used as a failure database; German data prune architecture rather than starting the program from zero. Twin-jet experimental airframe work can proceed in parallel, preferably podded engines for interchange/maintenance.

Best-case conditional window for first integrated Ne-20-like axial bench articles to make short runs if I-34 early observation plus later paper/hardware gates all succeed. This is an experimental engine, not a service engine. Without those gates, move this to Dec 1944-Feb 1945.

Conditional window for selected 20-30 minute damage-controlled bench endurance, fuel-control stabilization and flight-rated pairs. Hot-section life remains measured in short operational hours, not peacetime overhaul life.

Earliest centered window for a purpose-built twin-jet experimental aircraft first flight if the favorable I-34/I-29 information chain and engine bench gates both succeed. Center around Mar 1945; no 1944 combat jet.

Limited operational evaluation may be possible in reconnaissance/light-strike/point-intercept roles if production, fuel, pilot conversion and engine-life gates survive wartime disruption. Piston fighters remain the mass combat force.

airframe_and_mission_reaudit.why_not_copy_historical_Kikka_schedule: Historical Kikka was ordered in Sep 1944 under deteriorating-war pressure and Me262 influence. Branch has earlier domestic jet work and potentially earlier German information, but also less desperation to rush a one-way/short-life combat aircraft. Earlier engineering study does not automatically mean earlier operational deployment.
airframe_and_mission_reaudit.working_airframe_policy: Authorize an experimental twin-jet high-speed research/recon/light-attack airframe in mid-1944 only after thrust/mass envelopes become credible. Podded engines are favored for interchange, access and parallel domestic/German-derived engine testing.
airframe_and_mission_reaudit.fighter_role_limit: Early thrust-to-weight and engine life make a true high-performance fleet fighter harder than a research/recon/light-strike aircraft. Do not assume a 1944 'jet interceptor' solution to F6F/F4U/Spitfire performance.

rocket_Me163_HWK_branch.state_28Jan: No HWK509 physical motor or complete Me163 package in Japan.
rocket_Me163_HWK_branch.I34_future_text_effect: Can transmit concept, performance and broad propulsion/handling cautions after inspection but cannot replace drawings/pump/injector/control hardware.
rocket_Me163_HWK_branch.RO501_future: Potential blueprint route remains unresolved because its historical loss was direct ASW; Branch COMSEC does not erase it automatically.
rocket_Me163_HWK_branch.I29_future: Blueprints/personnel information can move from Singapore by air; physical HWK509A-1 requires the hardware gate.
rocket_Me163_HWK_branch.operational_limit: Peroxide/methanol-hydrazine handling, pump/injector seals, material compatibility, pilot training and ground-safety infrastructure remain major bottlenecks. No 1944 operational rocket interceptor.

industrial_and_organizational_constraint: 20-40 t Ni-equivalent priority research allocation supports prototype hot-section trials but not broad jet mass production.

Precision bearings, high-speed balancing, seals, compressor blade repeatability, thin-sheet combustor fabrication, turbine blade life, fuel controls and test-cell capacity remain scarce skills/equipment.
Army-Navy duplication is reduced by shared measurements/reports if I-34 opens the early information gate, but institutional rivalry and separate requirement chains remain.
Every jet-engine priority competes with Homare/Ha-43/Kinsei piston-engine production, supercharger research, radar/electronics, ship machinery and skilled tool-room labor.
More time and better information can rationally be spent on robust piston-aircraft production rather than forcing an immature jet into combat.

scenario_branches.A_favorable_I34_and_I29: I-34 Europe arrival + early text + return paper/small hardware + I-29 Singapore information + I-29 Japan bulky hardware. Ne20-like short bench Oct-Dec44, flight-rated pair Jan-Mar45, experimental twin-jet flight Feb-Apr45.
scenario_branches.B_I34_information_only_I29_information_n: Early axial pruning still occurs; exact hot-section/control replication slower. Ne20-like bench Dec44-Feb45; flight Mar-May45; aircraft flight Apr-Jun45.
scenario_branches.C_I34_fails_before_Europe_I29_historical: Reverts toward a corrected historical-like path: July44 photos/drawings become the first exact axial architecture input; Branch domestic baseline still shortens iteration, but first practical engine and aircraft remain 1945.
scenario_branches.D_no_German_jet_input: Domestic TR/Ne work continues as centrifugal/hybrid research and captive flight-test program. It may achieve experimental self-propelled flight later, but no credible 1944 operational jet and no automatic Ne20 architecture.

combat_relevance_by_year.1944: Engineering/test benefit only. No operational jet fighter, no Marianas jet CAP, no jet replacement for Kinsei-Zero/Raiden/Shiden-Kai/Reppu/Ki-84.
combat_relevance_by_year.1945: Potential limited experimental/operational evaluation if route and industrial gates succeed; quantities small and mission-specific.
combat_relevance_by_year.strategic_rule: The greatest 1944 value of the Yanagi jet cascade is reducing wrong design branches and building test/measurement capability, not battlefield aircraft count.

future_adjudication_triggers: When discussion clock reaches projected I-34 Europe-arrival window, adjudicate actual arrival/inspection and exact information transmitted.
When I-34 return begins, adjudicate manifest and return-route survival separately.
At I-29 Europe/Singapore gates, separate paper/personnel from Jumo/HWK physical cargo and do not invent BMW003 physical hardware.
At RO-501/I-52 dates, adjudicate direct ASW/COMINT mechanisms individually rather than granting automatic survival.
Recalculate jet dates after any major industrial bombing/resource shock rather than treating this schedule as guaranteed.
hard_guard: No 1944 operational jet or rocket combat unit is credited.
